rca of the issue: Root cause: WhatsApp italic marker `_..._` interpretation breaks when the content between markers contains an unescaped `_`. Since officine names use `Off_XXXX` format, wrapping full lines in `_..._` produced malformed italic runs → WhatsApp client rendered the whole reply as an empty message (still delivered per Meta API, but visually blank). Reproduction: seed garde_planning with assist_group, set an officine name containing `_`, previous code wrapped each officine line in `_...`_` → empty WA client render. Mitigation: keep italic only on the section title (which has no `_`) and use a visual prefix `↳ ` on each assist officine line. Confirmed via 6 direct-invocation tests on `_build_garde_reply`.
